title: Pay for a course
notSetUp: Payments aren't set up yet. Ask your school how to pay for this course.
rejected: The school couldn't confirm your payment (reference {reference}). Check the details and report it again.
rejectedNote: The school couldn't confirm your payment (reference {reference}): {note} Check the details and report it again.
name: Name
reported: Payment reported on {date} (reference <ref>{reference}</ref>). The school checks it and you'll get a notification. The course opens as soon as it's confirmed.
help: After paying, your UPI app shows a 12-digit reference (UTR or UPI transaction ID). Enter it here so the school can find your payment. A screenshot helps but isn't required.
badType: The screenshot must be a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
tooBig: The screenshot can be at most {mb} MB.
utrHint: Usually 12 digits, under the payment in your UPI app's history.
